text:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to originate release/1.16 next Tue (2026-03-24). Can someone take lead on creating the branch + initial version bump? Need changelog PR draft + backport owners for critical fixes. @sam @jordan
sam: I can create the branch tomorrow morning. What's the cutoff for commits to include?
maya: Cutoff = Thu EOD (2026-03-19) for main slice. After that only hotfixes via cherry-pick + approvals. Will post a short checklist.
jordan: Clarify backport policy: only bugfixes with regression label? Or doc/infra changes as well?
kevin: Policy = critical bugfixes + perf regressions + security. Docs/infra usually not backported unless they affect runtime. Use label 'backport-request' and add risk/impact note.
sasha: I'll own changelog. Can you drop the PR template snippet I should use?
maya: Thanks! Use this in header of changelog PR:

```markdown
- Release: 1.16
- Owner: @sasha
- Included PRs: #NNN, #MMM
- Notes: short summary
``` 
Also bump versions in pkg/version.go and charts/*/Chart.yaml.

release-bot: Reminder scheduled: branch-create job will run on Tue 09:00 UTC if owner not set. See <https://internal.redwood.dev/release-jobs>
sam: I ran the branch create command locally, sharing for next person:

```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
git push origin release/1.16
``` 
Will open the initial PR with version bump + changelog draft.
maya: Awesome — @sam please tag backport owners in the PR (cc @kevin). I'll update release calendar and ping customer teams.
jordan: Quick question: do we want to run the perf smoke in staging before the cut?
kevin: yes — run perf-smoke with seq=512 and long-tail config. If >=10% regression, hold and investigate.
sasha: Got it. I'll assemble changelog and link perf results in PR.
maya: Thanks all. Sam = branch lead, Sasha = changelog, Kevin = backport triage. I'll close the loop. :thumbsup:
